query: What will the manual audit rubric include (fields to record, photographic standards, inter-rater reliability thresholds, training protocol) and how will audits update automated thresholds?

response.query: What will the manual audit rubric include (fields to record, photographic standards, inter-rater reliability thresholds, training protocol) and how will audits update automated thresholds?
response.answer: The manual audit rubric will include fields for recording compliance data, photographic standards for evidence, inter-rater reliability thresholds of 90% or higher, and a training protocol for auditors. Audits will update automated thresholds based on compliance rates.
